maddeler.e:
تقارضت (form VI)
# تَقَارَضْتُ (taqāraḍtu) /ta.qaː.radˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# تَقَارَضْتَ (taqāraḍta) /ta.qaː.radˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# تَقَارَضْتِ (taqāraḍti) /ta.qaː.radˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# تَقَارَضَتْ (taqāraḍat) /ta.qaː.ra.dˤat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
